verdicts.reason: A breaks the product illustration: the pale circle is stranded at the far left, clipped by the edge, while the can sits alone at the far right. The SOLSTICE wordmark falls below the headline, the body copy is tiny and jammed against the badges, and big dead gaps are left on both sides. B reads left to right in a sensible order (brand, headline, intact can-in-circle, copy, CTA) with a strong headline, but the body copy is a narrow, tiny 5-line column, and the badges are scattered (BACK BY DEMAND next to the CTA, SUMMER ONLY dropped below it) rather than grouped.
